### [`bull_f64_parts`](../../../src/bull_sprites_extra.asm#L6) `$FB40-$FCFF`

*data*

### [`xsprites_ram_noise`](../../../src/bull_sprites_extra.asm#L387) `$FF80-$FFEF`
